title: 雅思小作文数据表达库
subtitle: 按数据图小作文常见说法整理表达、AI 补充讲解，并保留原文 125 条经典例句。
sourceDocument: 写作/图表作文经典例句.doc

categories.title: 上升与下降
categories.description: 用于描述数据增长、减少、回落、恢复、加速和放缓，是数据图小作文最核心的趋势语言。
categories.aiFocus: 动词和名词结构要交替使用，例如 rise / an increase，避免整篇只写 increase 或 decrease。

items.explanation: 最基础的上升表达，可用于数量、比例、消费、产量等。正式写作中可以和 from...to... 或 by... 搭配。
items.raw: go up / rise / increase 上升；增加

items.explanation: 强调前面已经上升，随后继续升至某个数值，适合描述连续增长。
items.raw: rise further to 进一步上升到

items.explanation: 常用于比较两个年份或时期，句式简洁，适合写概述后的细节。
items.raw: be up on 比之前高

items.explanation: 表示幅度很大、速度很快的下降，语气强于 fall 和 decline。
items.raw: plunge / plummet 暴跌；急剧下降

items.explanation: 通用下降表达。fall 偏自然变化，decline 更正式，drop 更直接。
items.raw: fall / decline / drop 下降；减少

items.explanation: 强调下降过程持续且平缓，可作名词短语放在 after / during 后面。
items.raw: a steady decline 稳定下降

items.explanation: 用于转折点，说明此前趋势结束，新的增长趋势开始。
items.raw: start to rise 开始上升

items.explanation: 强调增长速度平稳，没有剧烈波动。
items.raw: grow steadily 稳定增长

items.explanation: 名词结构，适合和具体百分比或数值搭配。
items.raw: a drop of 下降了多少

items.explanation: 表示数值接近两倍，不必精确等于两倍。
items.raw: roughly double 大约翻倍

items.term: be lost at the rate of
items.explanation: 常用于土地、资源、人口等持续减少的语境。
items.raw: be lost at the rate of 以某速度流失

items.explanation: 作为动词表示达到某个高数值，适合销售额、出口额、总量。
items.raw: top 达到；突破

items.explanation: 名词化趋势表达，适合放在概述或背景句中。
items.raw: be on the rise 处于上升趋势

items.explanation: 对应 be on the rise，强调整体处于减少状态。
items.raw: be in decline 处于下降趋势

items.explanation: 用于解释变化结果，适合结果类数据或预测数据。
items.raw: lead to fewer 导致更少

items.explanation: 表示增长、通胀或变化速度下降，但不一定变成负增长。
items.raw: moderate 放缓；趋缓

items.explanation: 用于把图中差距、比例变化和背后数据连接起来。
items.raw: reflect a drop / increase 反映下降/上升

examples.text: The proportion of the people who were divorced went up from 2.5% in 1981 to 7.5% in 1991, rising further to 8% in 2001.
The crop yields worldwide in 1990 were 15% up on those of 1985.
The number of shoppers during the Christmas period plunged by up to 23 per cent since then on.
After five years of steady decline, the high-school drop-out rate started to rise.
Oil consumption grew steadily from 1980 to 2000, apart from in 1990, when there was a drop of 5 per cent.
House prices fell as much as 40% between 1980 and 1985, compared with the period 1986 to 1990, when prices roughly doubled.
Arable land was being lost at the rate of over 38 thousand square miles per year throughout the 1980s.
Exports topped $10 billion in 2006, with those to Asia Pacific in excess of $2 billion.
The smoking rate in young girls was on the rise, similar to that among adult women.
Motorcycle casualties were in decline, down from a total of 54,037 in 1995 to 38,090 in 2000.
Gender equality would lead to 13.4 million fewer homeless children, a 13% reduction.
Inflation is likely to moderate through the early months of 2007.
The number of married couples showed a significant decline, accounting for 50.7% of the adult population, compared with 68% in 1971.
The smaller gap between movie-goers and television viewers reflected a 5% drop in the number of people who go to the cinema and a 1.2% increase in those who enjoy watching TV at home.

categories.title: 占比与构成
categories.description: 用于饼图、堆叠柱图、人口结构、支出构成和类别比例。
categories.aiFocus: 注意 constitute / comprise / account for 的主语不同：类别 account for 比例，整体 is composed of 类别。

items.explanation: 正式表达，主语通常是某个群体或类别，后接整体中的比例。
items.raw: constitute 构成；占据

items.explanation: 雅思小作文高频表达，主语是组成部分，宾语是比例或整体份额。
items.raw: account for 占据；占比为

items.explanation: 可表示某类别占整体，也可表示整体由若干部分组成；写作时注意主谓关系。
items.raw: comprise 包括；由……组成

items.explanation: 比 constitute 更自然，适合多数图表语境。
items.raw: make up 构成；占

items.explanation: 主语通常是整体，后面列出多个组成部分及比例。
items.raw: be composed of 由……组成

items.explanation: 用于描述某项在家庭支出、人口、预算中的占比。
items.raw: as a percentage of 作为……的百分比

items.explanation: 近似比例表达，避免所有数据都写精确百分比。
items.raw: nearly half of 将近一半

items.explanation: 当已列出主要部分后，用 the rest 简洁收尾。
items.raw: the rest 其余部分

examples.text: Volunters constitute nearly half of the work force of the health care sector.
While Asians account for 11 per cent of the American population, Hispanics comprise 8 per cent.
Women make up 52 per cent of the population of Britain.
Landfill is composed of 36% municipal waste, 24% commercial and industrial waste and 40% construction waste.

categories.title: 倍数与差距
categories.description: 用于描述两组数据之间的倍数关系、更多/更少、差额和差距扩大。
categories.aiFocus: 倍数表达要区分 twice as...as、three times as often as、four times more than 等结构。

items.explanation: 强调增长后数值超过原来的两倍，适合明显增长的数据。
variants: more than twice as much as
items.raw: more than double 超过两倍；翻了一倍多

items.explanation: 用于概率、风险、倾向，不直接用于数量。
items.raw: twice as likely to 可能性是……的两倍

items.explanation: 用于频次比较，例如使用互联网、出行、参与活动。
items.raw: three times as often as 频率是……的三倍

items.explanation: 主语通常是可数名词数量。
items.raw: almost twice as many as 数量几乎是……的两倍

items.explanation: 强调相对差距，不等于占比为 50%。
items.raw: 50% more than 比……多 50%

items.explanation: 语气强，适合金额、损失、数量等差距。
items.raw: four times more than 比……多四倍

items.explanation: 把倍数变化和最终数值放在同一句里。
items.raw: jump 1.5 times to 跃升 1.5 倍至

items.explanation: 用于总量差距，后面常接 the number / figure in another year。
items.raw: three times more than 比……多三倍

examples.text: Rent as a percentage of the household expenditure more than doubled between 1974 and 1998, from 5% to 12%.
Britons were twice as likely to die from heart attacks as Italians and three times as Chinese.
Women work as child minders in the under-35 age group in 1995 were almost twice as many as in 1990.
Television was twice as popular as washing machine in 1990,with close to 10 per cent of households owning one TV set at home.
Young people used the Internet more than three times as often as the general population in 1999.
The study found that people who earned more than $100,000 received nearly 50% more junk mails than lower earners.
It also found that those on higher incomes lost on average four times more money than other victims in property-related crime.
China's agricultural trade deficit against US jumped 1.5 times to $35 billion over the five-year period.

categories.title: 读数与比例
categories.description: 用于精确读图、近似读数、分数、总量、人均值和调查结果描述。
categories.aiFocus: 数据题不必每个数字都机械照抄，可以用 some、approximately、the majority of、fewer than 等表达精确度差异。

items.explanation: 分数表达，比 25% 更自然，适合正文细节。
items.raw: a quarter of 四分之一

items.explanation: 放在数字前表示近似值，语气比 approximately 更自然。
items.raw: some 大约；约有

items.explanation: 用于从总体中提取子群体，例如海外旅行者中的目的地分布。
items.raw: of those who 在那些……的人中

items.explanation: 用于估计数据，适合题目给出 approximate / estimated 的情况。
items.raw: with an estimated 据估计有

items.explanation: 用于总量表达，可放在 spent / sold / produced 等动词后。
items.raw: a total of 总共

items.explanation: 比 a total of 更正式，适合总数较大的统计。
items.raw: an aggregate of 总计

items.explanation: 用于人均支出、人均排放、人均收入等。
items.raw: per-capita 人均

items.explanation: 稳定、正式地引出某一数值。
items.raw: stand at 处于；为

items.explanation: 人口类和社会类图表常见表达。
items.raw: below poverty line 低于贫困线

items.explanation: less than 通常修饰不可数或比例，fewer than 修饰可数人数/数量。
items.raw: less than / fewer than 少于

items.explanation: 用于超过一半的比例，不必重复精确数字。
items.raw: the majority of 大多数

items.explanation: 自然比例表达，尤其适合人口、家庭、学生。
items.raw: one in ten 十分之一

items.explanation: 口语自然但写作也可用，适合调查结果。
items.raw: four in ten 十个中有四个

items.explanation: 强调数值高或比例大。
items.raw: as many as 多达

items.explanation: 用于列举后收尾，避免重复具体分类名称。
items.raw: the remaining 剩余的

items.explanation: 用于未来预测图。
items.raw: be projected to 预计将

examples.text: A quarter of the customers were African origin.
Some 700 migrants arrived to live in Australia every week in 2005.
Of those UK residents who traveled overseas, some 210,000 went to America.
The overall UK population was some 58 million in 2001, 17% higher than in 1995.
With an estimated 100 million international migrants worldwide, the proportion of people living outside their country of birth approached 2 per cent of the world's population in 2002.
Americans spent a total of $12.5 billion on gifts in 2005 alone, with $6.5 billion of that on toys.
An aggregate of 40,000 households bought new vehicles, three times more than the number in 2004.
The per-capita spending of visitors in China stood at 1,000 US dollars or so in 2000, a year-on-year rise of one per cent.
Indonesia is still an impoverished country, with the population below poverty line exceeding half a billion.
The number of people living on less than $1 a day in Asia dropped by nearly a quarter of a billion people between 1990 and 2002.
Two-parent families now work an average of almost 400 more hours a year than they did 20 years ago.
There were 100,000 more people working on full-time basis in 2004 than in 1994.
It is shown in the chart that up to two million children were orphaned in 2002 in Africa, half a million higher than the 2001's record figure.
It was discovered that less than a fifth of the public money went to education.
Two-fifths of the population are suffering different levels of obesity.
Between half and two-thirds of smokers die of something other than smoking.
More than one-third of the British population has trouble sleeping from time to time.
In total,1,400 magazines were sold within a week-200 a day-more than half of which were for female readers.
Currently, approximately 6,000 languages still exist, the majority of which are under threat.
Cohabiting couples made up one in ten of the population in 1999-double the number a decade earlier.
A staggering four in ten students had the experience of using marijuana.
Fewer than three in ten people were ethnic minorities.
According to the survey, a billion and a half of the worlds's had no access to electricity in the year 2004, and almost as many lacked electricity in 2005.
80% of drinks containers in Britain are recycled-far higher than the European average of 20% to 40%.
The world population is projected to grow from 6 billion in 1999 to 9 billion by 2042.an increase of 50 per cent that will require 43 years.
Just 18% of smokers were planning to give up smoking, while a further 42.4% said that they would "possibly" do so.
As many as 78% of men were doing administrative work, whereas women who were working as sales and customer services staff rose to a record 75%.
About 42 per cent of students chose science as their subject, 40 per cent engineering and the rest arts.

40% of respondents said that students should be responsible for university fees, another 40% considered it the responsibility of the government, and the remaining 20% viewed it as a shared responsibility.
The number of people enrolling for adult education courses increased by about 5% in 1999,lower than those for 1995 and 1996, when 1.5 million and 1.8 million people respectively were enrolled.

categories.title: 时间与阶段
categories.description: 用于描述年份、阶段、起止时间、此前此后、某阶段内的变化。
categories.aiFocus: 时间表达最好和趋势动词绑定，例如 by 2005 表示到某时为止，prior to 表示在某变化之前。

items.explanation: 用于承接前文时间点，说明后续趋势。
items.raw: since then 自那以后

items.explanation: 最常用的时间范围表达。
items.raw: between...and... 在……和……之间

items.explanation: 用于月度变化比较。
items.raw: a month earlier 一个月前

items.explanation: 强调截至某时已经达到的结果。
items.raw: by the end of 到……末为止

items.translation: 从 20 世纪 70 年代起
items.explanation: 用于从某阶段开始持续的变化。
items.raw: from the 1970s onwards 从 20 世纪 70 年代起

items.explanation: 表示持续时长，带近似语气。
items.raw: for twenty years or so 大约二十年

items.explanation: 总括某一时间段的变化。
items.raw: over the period 在整个时期内

items.explanation: 适合精确说明开始和结束时间。
items.raw: during the period from...to... 在从……到……期间

items.explanation: 避免重复题目年份范围。
items.raw: in those given years 在给定年份中

items.explanation: 用于年龄组比较。
items.raw: aged between...and... 年龄在……之间

items.explanation: 用于先降后升、先平后升等转折。
items.raw: before a substantial increase 在大幅上升之前

items.explanation: 比 before 更正式。
items.raw: prior to 在……之前

items.explanation: 适合描述先发生某趋势，再进入另一状态。
items.raw: after experiencing 在经历……之后

items.explanation: 用于某趋势持续到某年为止。
items.raw: up to the year 直到某年

items.explanation: 适合长时间跨度，比如一个世纪。
items.raw: over the course of 在……过程中

examples.text: Since then, growth had started to accelerate, up to 3 per cent on average annually between 1995 and 2000.
Consumer spending rose 0.5% in November after an increase of 0.3% a month earlier.
The industrial output growth had slowed to 2% by 2005.
By the end of 2005, nearly 30% of commuters used public transport, a slight increase on the figures for 2003.
Britain's GDP is expected to surpass that of France by the end of 2010.
In 1993, 60% of Vietnam's population was classified as being under the internationally-accepted poverty line, but that figure had fallen to less than 20% by 2004.
From the 1970s onwards, the volume of exports underwent a period of growth.
For twenty years or so, there was an upward trend in the number of deaths caused by heart disease.
There was a steady increase in the enlistment of the armed force in Vietnam over the period 1970 to 1980
The secondary school enrolment rate sank considerably after an increase of 10 per cent during the period from the mid-1980s to the early 1990s.
Although 70 per cent of the smokers said they wanted to quit smoking, a mere 3 per cent of them were successful in those given years.
By age 15, Americans are less likely to smoke than Europeans, although the 10-to-13-year-olds in America are as likely to smoke as European 10-to-13-year-olds.
Someone who starts smoking aged 15 is three times more likely to die of cancer due to smoking than someone who starts in late 20s.
Overall, 11% of people aged between 35 and 45 in the UK said that they were not in good health.
The PCs sold dipped 30% to 12.3 million in 2001, before a substantial increase in the following three years.
Prior to a surge to record high in 1983, food supplies stagnated for nearly ten years.
After experiencing alarming increase during the second half of the 1990s, juvenile delinquency was at its lowest level for at least five years.
The reported crime rate dropped more than 5%, compared to the same time in 2005.
Carbon dioxide emissions were rising by less than 2% annually up to the year 1999, but now rising at 4% or so per year.
The popularity of some activities, such as jigsaw puzzle, declined noticeably as the age increases.
There was a downward trend in the years 1998 and 1999.
Over the course of the last century, the global population rose from under two billion to just over six billion.
Australia's share of Japanese tourist market shrank from 9% to 2% in just a 10-year period.

categories.title: 平稳与波动
categories.description: 用于描述 plateau、flat、steady、constant、stagnate、fluctuate 等非单向变化。
categories.aiFocus: reach a plateau 指上升后到达高位并保持不变；stagnate 更偏停滞，常带负面含义。

items.explanation: 通常表示上升后到达较高水平并保持不变，不再继续明显增长。
items.raw: reach a plateau 达到平台期

items.explanation: 最标准的波动表达，需要给出上下限。
items.raw: fluctuate between...and... 在……和……之间波动

items.explanation: 名词结构，适合描述 birth rates、prices、temperatures。
items.raw: strong fluctuations 剧烈波动

items.explanation: 强调数值没有明显变化。
items.raw: remain flat at 保持在某水平

items.term: rise and fall within a narrow range
items.explanation: 用于轻微波动，不应写成 dramatic fluctuation。
items.raw: rise and fall within a narrow range 在小范围内上下波动

items.explanation: 比 remain stable 更强调几乎没有变化。
items.raw: remain static 保持静止；无变化

items.explanation: 中性表达，适合价格、比例、数量。
items.raw: remain steady 保持稳定

items.explanation: 强调变化率或水平固定。
items.raw: remain constant 保持恒定

items.explanation: 用于先快速变化后稳定在某一水平附近。
items.raw: remain around that figure 维持在该数值附近

items.explanation: 表示经历变化后进入稳定状态。
items.raw: stabilize at 稳定在

items.explanation: 常用于产量、供应、经济数据，暗示缺乏增长。
items.raw: stagnate 停滞

items.explanation: 比 fluctuations 更书面，适合温度、指数等。
items.raw: slight oscillations 轻微震荡

examples.text: The population reached a plateau in 1990, before declining suddenly in 2001.
The annual population growth rate fluctuated between 1% and 2% during the ten-year period.
There were strong fluctuations in birth rates throughout the five years from 1995 to 2000.
In spite of a growth in the working population, the unemployment rate was flat at 7.8%.
The output rose and fell within a narrow range between 41.2 million tons and 51.2 million tons.
The number of the young people obtaining qualifications remained static (slightly above 30%).
LCD TV prices remained steady for three years in a row apart from (despite, except) a slump in 2003.
The mobile phone owner growth remained constant and averaged,1 per cent per year in both the US and the UK up to 2003.
Enrolments rose dramatically to more than half a million and remained around that figure in 1965.
The unemployment rate stabilized at a higher level by around 1995.
Industrial production continued to stagnate, after 12 years of tremendous growth.
There had been slight oscillations in temperature throughout the 1970s and 1980s.

categories.title: 峰值与历史值
categories.description: 用于最高点、最低点、历史纪录、新高新低、峰值和连续变化。
categories.aiFocus: peak 是达到峰值后可能回落；reach an all-time record 强调历史最高纪录；a new low 强调新低。

items.explanation: 用于说明某数值达到过去十年中的最高水平。
variants: the highest level in ten years
items.raw: a ten-year high 十年来高点

items.explanation: 强调所有记录中最高或最突出。
items.raw: reach an all-time record 达到历史纪录

items.explanation: 用于雨量、价格、比例等低于此前记录。
items.raw: a new low 新低

items.explanation: 语气强，适合极端增长。
items.raw: an unprecedented rise 前所未有的上升

items.explanation: 后接具体数值或比例。
items.raw: peak at 在……达到峰值

items.explanation: 用于比较多个类别或时期中的最大变化。
items.raw: the greatest increase 最大增幅

items.explanation: 强调数据虽有波动但整体仍高。
items.raw: remain high 保持高位

items.explanation: 用于精确历史排名。
items.raw: the fourth lowest on record 有记录以来第四低

examples.text: UK trade deficit with China rose almost 10% to 3 billion, a ten-year high.
The proportion of single-parent families reached an all-time record of 15%.
Auckland received no more than 200 mm of rain per month on average in 1990, a new low in the twenty-year period.
The total number of regular Internet users experienced an unprecedented rise in 2002, its sixth annual rise in a row.
Britain's crime rate peaked at 9% or so in 1999.
The greatest increase was in the proportion of the people who are overweight, 15% up from 8% in 1989.
Unemployment figures remained high, ranging from 12.5% to 15%.
Youngsters spent a mere 5% of their pocket money on cigarettes in 2003, the fourth lowest on record.

categories.title: 排序与对比
categories.description: 用于排名、领先、落后、超过、相反变化、对比和差距描述。
categories.aiFocus: 排序类表达要注意 ranked、came second、followed behind、overtook、far ahead of 等动词和介词搭配。

items.explanation: 用于国家、类别、行业排名。
items.raw: rank in the top five 位列前五

items.explanation: 排名下降，语气比 fall to 更贴近排名场景。
items.raw: slip to seventh 滑落至第七

items.explanation: 强调排名或数值第一。
items.raw: lead other countries 领先其他国家

items.explanation: 用于第二、第三名描述。
items.raw: follow behind 紧随其后

items.explanation: 排名类高频表达。
items.raw: come second 位居第二

items.explanation: 强调竞争排名中的超越。
items.raw: beat...into third place 超过……使其退居第三

items.explanation: 用于排名提升。
items.raw: rise two places to 上升两位至

items.explanation: 自然排名表达，适合榜单。
items.raw: come in at 14th 位列第 14

items.explanation: 正式表达，用于两组整体比较。
items.raw: compare favorably with 优于；相比表现更好

items.explanation: 用于第二大/第二高类别。
items.raw: closely followed by 紧随其后的是

items.explanation: 强调差距大。
items.raw: far ahead of 远远领先于

items.explanation: 用于排名或总量后来居上。
items.raw: overtake 超过；赶超

items.explanation: 用于对比平均值或另一国家数据。
items.raw: lower than / far below 低于 / 远低于

items.explanation: 用于两个类别反向变化或差异对比。
items.raw: while / whereas 而；然而

items.explanation: 表示差距非常小。
items.raw: marginally larger than 略大于

items.explanation: 用于一个趋势和另一个趋势不一致。
items.raw: at odds with 与……相反

items.translation: 随着年龄增长趋于一致
items.explanation: 表示差异逐渐消失。

items.explanation: 正式对比表达，适合强烈差异。

items.explanation: 较正式，用于两个数据直接对照。
items.raw: as against 相比之下；而

examples.text: The US ranked in the world's top five as a car manufacturer in 1985,but slipped to seventh in 1990 and plummeted to tenth in 1995.
Japan led other countries in life expectancy (81.2 years); Australia and Canada followed behind, 80.55 years and 80.2 years respectively.
The latest figures show that China has come second in terms of GDP, following the lead of the United States and narrowly beating Japan into third place,
France has risen two places to number four in the OECD countries, behind America, Japan and Britain.
Saturn is the second largest planet after Jupiter; with a diameter nearly ten times that of Earth.
In the terms of GDP, Mexico, which did not appear in the top 20 in 2000, came in at 14th in 2005.
While the Asian countries compare favorably with their European counterparts, several have dropped in ranking.
Practical crafts was the most popular subject area, with an enrolment rate of 45%, closely followed by physical education and sport.
The US was ahead with an increase of 10% and China came second with 8%.
China is the world's most populous country, with a population of more than 1.4 billion, far ahead of India, with 1 billion people.
China overtook America in 1999 and became the largest export country.
In 1999, Australia ranked second, behind the USA, in terms of domestic waste generation.
The population growth in the UK was lower than the European Union average of 23% and far below the growth in the United States (80%) over the same period.
Students made up the biggest proportion of employees in low paid occupations (65%), while high school students were most likely to have a professional job (40%).
While the number of full-time female workers grew, that of full-time male workers declined.
Whereas developing countries more than doubled car emissions, from 3 billion to 6.2 billion, industrialized countries cut theirs by half, from 4 billion down to 2 billion
The population of France is only marginally larger than that of Britain.
The drop in 1995 was at odds with the sharp rise in 1999.
With regards to government spending on education, there was a sharp reduction during the five-year-long period (223 million in 1989 versus 110 million in 1994).
The income differences between sexes even out with age.
In Africa, there are around 14 women living with HIV for every 10 men.
The proportion of homeowners was as high as 78% in 1989, in marked contrast to a mere 35% a decade earlier.
Women were more likely to be part-time workers throughout the 1990s,with more than two out of five women working part-time, compared with one in ten men.
The jobless rate in 1990 was 4%, the lowest level in more than ten years, as against 10% in 1980.
Among the leading reasons why an adult considered education in 2004, 65% said that it was helpful, while 24% chose it simply because they loved studying.
The average American produces 6 tonnes of carbon dioxide, a Chinese 0.7 tonnes and an Indian 0.25 tonnes.
